lw_glass_ghoul.name: Glass Ghoul
lw_glass_ghoul.desc: A glassblower who never went up for his supper. Fifty years at the furnace have fused him to his own work, and he is brittle all the way through. He still tries to polish things.

moves.name: Shard Claw
moves.tell: drags a hand of broken glass

moves.name: Molten Spit
moves.tell: gathers a glowing bead behind its teeth

lw_lampling.name: Lampling
lw_lampling.desc: A lamp that was finished but never collected, and went looking for its owner on three brass legs. It is not unkind. It only wants to be lit.

moves.name: Gutter
moves.tell: gutters, and your own flame leans toward it

lw_foreman.name: The Last Foreman
lw_foreman.desc: Corm Vaskel's last invention: a foreman of brass and riveted iron, built to mind the workshop when he could not. It has minded it for fifty years, and lately it has begun to speak in his voice.

moves.name: Tighten Up
moves.tell: tightens a rivet in its own shoulder

moves.name: Spark Shower
moves.tell: strikes the bench and the sparks fly your way

moves.name: Gather Heat
moves.tell: is glowing white. POUR THE CRUCIBLE is coming

Pour the Crucible.name: Pour the Crucible
Pour the Crucible.tell: tips the white-hot crucible over the bench

phases.msg: Corm's apron smoulders. The Foreman straightens, and speaks in a voice that is not his: 'Mind the edge, lad.'

moves.tell: tightens a rivet in its own shoulder

moves.name: Careful Now
moves.tell: squints along the edge of the hammer, taking its time
